anomalies.observed: The STM32H753 VCAP pins 48 and 73 are assigned to UART3_TX_FCC and UART3_RX_FCC. The STM32F405 VCAP_1 pin 31 and VCAP_2 pin 47 are also assigned to signal nets. No VCAP capacitors are shown.
anomalies.expected: The MCUs' VCAP pins should have their required capacitors to ground and should not be used as signal connections.

evidence.quote: FCC1: pins 48 and 73 are labeled VCAP and connected to UART3_TX_FCC and UART3_RX_FCC; no VCAP capacitors are shown (FCC sheet, page 2).
NAVC1: pins 31 and 47 are labeled VCAP_1 and VCAP_2 and connected to signal nets; no VCAP capacitors are shown (NAVC sheet, page 3).
Flight Control Computer MCU: STM32H753VITx; Navigation Computer MCU: STM32F405RGTx.

anomalies.impact: The VCAP pins provide the MCUs' internal core-regulator supply and require local capacitors. Loading them with signal nets and omitting those capacitors can prevent reliable MCU operation or damage the core supply; the assigned interfaces will also not function as intended.

parsed.summary: Both MCU sheets connect VCAP pins to signal nets and omit the required VCAP capacitors. This is a serious power-connection error that can prevent reliable operation of the flight-control and navigation processors.
